## Reading it — two things the table cannot say on its own

* **"compiled" and "best" are not one configuration across columns.** ms/step, floor, gap and % BW use Part B's best RUNG per model (named in the table). GPU idle, SM occupancy and the E5b columns use C1/E5's `best`, which for the LeRobot models is `--compile-mode reduce-overhead` and for GR00T is `--head-mode reduce-overhead --llm-mode max-autotune-no-cudagraphs`. They are the nearest committed matches, not identical builds.
* **GR00T's stall columns cover `ae_total`'s first 40 captured kernels**, not one step: its loop has no per-step wrap point. The LeRobot columns cover `ae_step_0`.
